name: Janelle Stelson
desc: American politician, former television news anchor
summary:
Janelle Stelson (born 1960) is an American former television news anchor and politician who is the U.S. representative-elect for Pennsylvania's 10th congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party, Stelson defeated Republican incumbent Scott Perry in 2026, whom she had narrowly lost to in 2024.
She worked as a television journalist in Pennsylvania for more than three decades, including 26 years as an anchor at WGAL-TV in Lancaster.
